segments.title: 필요한 크기를 풀기
segments.screenPlan: All eight source algebra rows retained progressive substitution; k=(1+e)(vrel·n)/[(1/m1+1/m2)(n·n)]. Nonunitn rescalesk,invariantkn.
segments.text: Subtract the new velocities and dot with the normal. Require the result to equal minus restitution times the incoming normal component. Collect terms containing k: the numerator is one plus restitution times the incoming normal dot product; the denominator is the sum of inverse masses times normal length squared. A unit normal makes the last factor one.
sourceFormulaBlocks:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf v'_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
(\mathbf v'_1-\mathbf v'_2)\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
[(\mathbf v_1-k\mathbf n/m_1)-(\mathbf v_2+k\mathbf n/m_2)]\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
[(\mathbf v_1-\mathbf v_2)-(k\mathbf n/m_1+k\mathbf n/m_2)]\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
[\mathbf v_{\rm rel}-k(1/m_1+1/m_2)\mathbf n]\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n-k(1/m_1+1/m_2)\mathbf n\cdot\mathbf n&=-e\,\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
k(1/m_1+1/m_2)\mathbf n\cdot\mathbf n&=(e+1)\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n,\\
k&=\frac{(e+1)\mathbf v_{\rm rel}\cdot\mathbf n}{(1/m_1+1/m_2)\mathbf n\cdot\mathbf n}.\tag{12.23}
\end{aligned}
$$
